newFeatures: Introduced a premium Liquid Glass navigation bar with a translucent glass design, colourful reflections, and a spacious capsule-shaped layout.
Added a water-fluid switching animation that stretches, morphs, and flows smoothly between active navigation tabs.
Added tap and finger-drag tab switching so the liquid indicator follows your finger and settles smoothly on the selected destination.
improvements: Optimized navigation animations for smoother, lag-free performance with efficient GPU rendering and reduced unnecessary calculations.
Completed APK size optimization including code shrinking, resource optimization, unused dependency removal, image compression, and native library packaging improvements.
Preserved all existing streaming features, 4K UHD video playback, EAX 4.1 surround sound, subtitles, audio tracks, and provider integrations.
bugFixes: Eliminated frame stutters during rapid tab tapping and continuous finger-drag navigation gestures.
Resolved an issue where external subtitle tracks could reset when switching streaming sources.
Fixed occasional playback state loss after rotating between portrait and landscape modes.
